channel.title: Under the Hood
channel.description: How the internet actually works, one week at a time.

item.title: HTTP without the guesswork
item.description: One page load as six clocks, what a request and a response really contain, the status codes that mislead, the headers that matter in production, what HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 changed, why retries need rules, and five real outages that show where each piece breaks.

item.title: DNS without the confusion
item.description: What happens, step by step, between typing a name and getting a byte back, the three record types that carry the web, why a DNS change never really "propagates", and five real outages that show where each piece breaks.
